evidence_tier: executed differential (tier 1), against the OpenMS4 Linux x86_64 Release libOpenMS through an oracle driver; class-test literals (tier 3); resource ceilings (tier 4)
method: Lane F3a (wave 4) ported PepXMLFileMascot. ../oracle/F3a-pepxml-mascot/driver.cpp, built on ibminode06 (never ibminode05) with the Release install's own conda g++ 14.4.0 and libOpenMS's core flags against /ceph/ibmi/abi/oliver/opt/openms4-release-bc9cc12-c19e494-174b576, loaded the upstream class-test fixture and 27 generated inputs, each in a fresh process with a clean environment, twice; both runs agreed byte for byte (results/differ.txt empty). The driver prints the map (title, toString and toUnmodifiedString of each sequence) or the exception, and the handler's OPENMS_LOG_ERROR lines go to stderr. A second invocation loads a throwing file and then a good file with one object, recording that the source keeps its variable modifications after a throw. tests/pepxml_mascot.rs renders this port's load in the driver's format and compares it line by line, the log line by line, and each exception with the crate error kind documented for it.
